name: Peppermint Academy
source:
A cute western bara visual novel with RPG combat, where you can build a party, collect monsters, and have a romance with hot guys.

Peppermint Academy is a strange school that brings together humans, demons, and angels from many different worlds. It is colorful and a little chaotic, but the romances are surprisingly personal and grounded.

Behind the cute art and fantasy setting, this is a game about relationships, emotional baggage, and learning how to connect with people who are not perfect, including yourself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款画风可爱的欧美壮男向视觉小说，融合了RPG战斗玩法，你可以在其中组建队伍、收集魔物，并与性感帅哥谈一场恋爱。

薄荷学院是一所奇妙的学校，汇聚了来自诸多不同世界的人类、恶魔与天使。这里色彩缤纷又略带几分混乱，但每段恋情却出人意料地细腻真挚、贴近人心。

在可爱的画风与奇幻设定背后，这是一个关于人际关系、情感包袱，以及学会如何与包括自己在内的不完美之人建立联结的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414820/]Steam[/url]]
